runs.str: Click a point on the grid to see if you have found anything. To open the squares
surrounding that point, click the “click and type coordinates” box and type the coordinates
of the point. Then click Enter. You earn points by uncovering dinosaur eggs, fossils, and
bones. The point value for each is listed. You can earn a total of 300 points for finding all of
the remains. You lose 4 points every time you enter the coordinates incorrectly. When you
are ready to play, or you want to start a new game, click Start. If you need to hear the
directions again at any time, click Repeat Directions.
